DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の担当を確認します。あなたは資材の運搬です。経路図で疑問に思う所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's confirm this morning's assignments. You will transport materials. Is there anything on the route map you are unsure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この短い道を通れば早そうですが、途中に囲まれた区画があります。そこを通ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 囲まれた区画を運搬で通ってよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This shorter path looks quicker, but there is a fenced-off section along it. May I go through that area?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm whether you may pass through the fenced-off section while transporting materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その区画は今回の担当経路に含めません。指定した通路を使ってください。区画の表示も現地で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That section is not included in your assigned route this time. Please use the designated passage. Let's also check the signs at the section itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い道へは入らず、指定の通路を使います。ただ、通路の終わりに別の作業者がいるようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 制限区画を避け通路終点の別作業を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't enter the shorter path; I'll use the designated passage. However, there seems to be another worker at the end of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the restricted section and report the other work at the end of the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け渡しの場所を確認してから進めましょう。作業中の人に近づいて、ご自分で置き場所を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's confirm the handover location before proceeding. Don't approach people who are working and decide where to put things yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け渡しの場所が決まるまで待ちます。運ぶ物が大きい場合も、一人で始めず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受け渡し場所と大きな資材の運び方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait until the handover location has been decided. If the items are large, I'd also like to ask how to move them rather than starting alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the handover location and how to transport large materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさと重さを見て運び方を決めます。変更があれば私へ連絡してください。連絡方法はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll decide how to transport them after checking their size and weight. Contact me if anything changes. Do you know how to reach me?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は聞きましたが、作業中にどこへ連絡するか聞いていません。連絡場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者に報告する方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've heard your name, but I haven't been told where to contact you during work. Please tell me where I can reach you.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to report to the supervisor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 朝礼の連絡表で私の連絡先を確認しましょう。経路が塞がった場合も、別の区画へ勝手に回らず報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check my contact details on the morning briefing's contact sheet. If the route is blocked, report it instead of going into another section on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡表を確認し、受け渡し先と運び方が決まってから指定通路を使います。塞がったら回り道を決めず報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定通路を使い塞がったら勝手に迂回せず報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the contact sheet and use the designated passage after the handover destination and transport method are decided. If it's blocked, I'll report it rather than choosing a detour myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the designated passage and report any blockage without taking a detour on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当と連絡方法をそろえてから始めましょう。私は受け渡し先を確認してきます。それでは、持ち場でまた声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's start once the assignments and contact arrangements are clear. I'll go and confirm the handover destination. I'll speak to you again at your station.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 同じ作品の表示が二つありますね。ご希望の上映について伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There are two listings for the same film, aren't there? Would you like help with the screening you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人で観ます。字幕付きの回を探していますが、この二つの表示は何が違うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で字幕の回を探し二つの表示の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm coming with a friend, so there are two of us. We're looking for a subtitled screening. What's the difference between these two listings?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two of you want a subtitled screening and ask how the two listings differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の上映形式と開始時刻を見比べましょう。題名が同じでも、形式が違う場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the screening formats and start times in the listings. Even with the same title, the formats may differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらには字幕、もう一方には吹替とあります。字幕の回で、二人が隣に座れるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 字幕を選び隣り合う二席を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one says subtitled, and the other says dubbed. I'd like to know whether we can sit next to each other at the subtitled screening.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the subtitled screening and check for two adjacent seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 座席の状況を確認します。隣り合う候補が見つかっても、購入前に座席番号を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the seating availability. Even if we find adjacent seats, please check the seat numbers before purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を確認します。友人はまだ来ていないので、購入する前に開始時刻を伝えて参加できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始時刻を友人へ伝えて参加可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the numbers. My friend hasn't arrived yet, so before buying, I'd like to tell them the start time and ask whether they can make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the start time and ask whether they can attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人のご予定も確認してください。確認中に座席の状況が変わることもあるため、購入時にもう一度見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your friend's plans as well. Seat availability may change while you are checking, so let's look again when you purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話のあとで空席を見直します。座席を選んだだけでは、購入が済んだことにはならないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡後に席を再確認し選択だけでは未購入と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the available seats again after the call. Simply selecting seats doesn't mean the purchase is complete, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you understand you need to recheck the seats after contacting your friend and that selecting them alone is not a completed purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、購入完了の表示まで確認してください。字幕の回と二人分の座席が合っているか、最終確認もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Please make sure the purchase-complete message appears. Please also make a final check that it is the subtitled screening and the correct seats for two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に時刻を聞いてから、字幕の回と並びの二席を選びます。完了表示が出るまで購入済みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 字幕と二席と完了表示を確認して購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the time with my friend, I'll select the subtitled screening and two seats together. I won't consider them purchased until I see the completion message.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the subtitled screening, both seats, and the completion message when purchasing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご連絡が済んだらまたこちらへお越しください。上映回と座席を一緒に確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come back here once you've contacted your friend. We'll check the screening and seats together. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このテーブルは天板を伸ばせます。普段は何人でお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The top of this table extends. How many people will normally use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段は二人ですが、友人が来たら四人で使いたいです。閉じたときの寸法なら部屋に置けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人から四人で使う伸縮テーブルを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Usually two, but I'd like to use it for four when friends visit. It looks as though it would fit in the room when closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an extending table to use for two to four people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 広げた寸法も確認しましょう。椅子を引く場所や、人が通る空間も必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the extended dimensions too. You'll also need room to pull out the chairs and space for people to walk past.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広げたときの幅は測っていませんでした。部屋では扉の近くに置く予定なので、扉が開く範囲も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 伸ばす寸法と扉が開く範囲を調べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I hadn't measured how wide it would be when extended. I plan to put it near the door, so I'll also check the space needed to open the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the extended dimensions and the area swept by the opening door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配置図に扉と椅子を入れてみると考えやすいです。伸ばす操作はここで実物をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Adding the door and chairs to a layout drawing can make it easier to think about. Would you like to see how the actual table extends here?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 操作を見たいです。自分で触る前に、動かす順序と手を置く場所を説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 触る前に順序と手を置く場所を教わる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to see how it works. Before I touch it myself, could you explain the order of the steps and where to put my hands?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Before touching it, ask to be shown the steps and where to place your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明してから実演します。ご購入を考える際は、配送や組立についても確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain and then demonstrate it. When considering a purchase, let's also check delivery and assembly.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 組立も頼みたいのですが、配送の料金に含まれているとは限らないのですね。範囲と費用を分けて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配送と組立の範囲や費用を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to request assembly too, but that isn't necessarily included in the delivery charge, is it? I'd like to ask separately about the scope and costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the scope and charges for delivery and assembly separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配送と組立を分けて確認します。設置場所が決まってから、条件に合う方法を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check delivery and assembly separately. Once you've decided where to put it, let's discuss an arrangement that meets the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 閉じた寸法と広げた寸法、扉と椅子の空間を調べ直します。配置が決まってから配送と組立を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの寸法と空間を調べてから配送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll recheck the closed and extended dimensions, and the space for the door and chairs. Once I've decided on the layout, I'll ask about delivery and assembly.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check both sets of dimensions and the available space before discussing delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な寸法を控えてお渡ししますね。配置図ができたらお持ちください。次のご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll write down the dimensions you need and give them to you. Please bring your layout drawing when it's ready. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は紙の小物を作ります。手順を見て、難しそうな所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we're making small paper crafts. Looking at the steps, is there anything that seems difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 厚い台紙を切る所が不安です。普段のはさみで切ったことがないので、使い方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚い台紙を切る前に道具の使い方を教わる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm worried about cutting the thick card. I haven't cut it with ordinary scissors before, so please show me how to use them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to use the tool before cutting the thick card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切る前に、道具と持ち方を説明します。まず薄い練習紙で動きを確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before you cut, I'll explain the tool and how to hold it. First, let's check the movement using thin practice paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 練習紙なら切れましたが、曲がる線から外れました。台紙へ進む前に、もう一度練習してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 曲がる線を外れたため台紙の前に練習し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I could cut the practice paper, but I went off the curved line. May I practice again before moving on to the card?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you went off the curved line and want to practice again before using the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もちろんです。無理に細かい部分を切らず、難しい箇所は私へ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Don't force yourself to cut the fine details; call me over for any difficult sections.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 細い所は手伝っていただきたいです。切る位置を鉛筆で示してから、お渡しすればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 細い部分の位置を示して職人に切ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like help with the narrow parts. Should I mark where to cut with a pencil before handing it to you?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mark the narrow parts and ask the craft instructor to cut them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 位置を示して確認しましょう。道具の受け渡し方もここで説明しますので、先に持って移動しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's mark the places and check them. I'll also explain here how to hand over the tool, so don't pick it up and walk over before that.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け渡しの説明を待ちます。切り終えた後の折る工程は、自分で試してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具の説明を待ち折る工程を試せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait for the explanation about handing it over. After the cutting is finished, may I try the folding step myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the tool instructions and ask whether you may try the folding step. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 折る線を一緒に確認してから試しましょう。のりを使う前にも向きを確かめると、貼り直しを減らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the fold lines together before you try. Checking the orientation before applying glue will also reduce the need to stick things down again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切る練習をして、難しい所は位置を示してお願いし、折る線と向きを確認してから仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 練習と補助と折る向きの確認を経て仕上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll practice cutting, mark the difficult places and ask for help, then check the fold lines and orientation before finishing.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will finish after practicing, getting help, and checking the folding direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番で作っていきましょう。困ったら道具を置いて呼んでください。完成した小物を持ち帰るときにも確認しますね。体験を楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's work in that order. If you have trouble, put down the tool and call me. We'll also check the finished craft when you take it home. Enjoy the workshop.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の変更後に届いた通知についてですね。通知と申込みの記録を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a notice that arrived after your address change, correct? Could you show me the notice and the record of your request?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所変更を申し込んだのに、前の住所へ通知が届きました。登録が変わっていないのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 変更申込み後も旧住所へ届いた状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I requested an address change, but a notice was delivered to my old address. I'm worried that the registered address hasn't changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a notice went to your old address even after you requested a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込日と通知に書かれた日付を比べ、登録の状況も確認しましょう。通知が届いた日だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the request date with the date on the notice and check the registration status too. We can't judge just from the date it arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申込みの控えはこちらです。通知には申込みより前の日付がありますが、それで問題ないと決めずに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知日が前でも登録完了と決めつけず確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my copy of the request. The notice is dated before the request, but I don't want to assume that means everything is fine; I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check rather than assuming the registration is complete just because the notice is dated earlier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ登録の確認を依頼します。登録住所と通知の送付先が、どう扱われているかも一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge to check the registration. Let's also confirm how the registered address and the mailing address for notices are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所が更新されていても、通知の送付先まで同じとは限らないのですね。次の通知がどこへ行くかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録住所と次の通知先を分けて知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if the address has been updated, the notice mailing address may not be the same, then. I'd also like to ask where the next notice will be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the registered address and the destination of the next notice separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた内容を分けてお伝えします。今の住所を示す情報についても、必要な確認を担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the confirmed details separately. The person in charge will also guide you through any necessary checks on information showing your current address.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい住所を示す資料も持っています。必要なら見せますので、何を確認するのか説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料を見せる前に確認内容の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also have documents showing my new address. I'll show them if needed, so could you explain what you'll be checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what will be checked before showing your documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認内容をご説明してから拝見します。未完了の項目がある場合は、続けて何が必要かもお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain what we need to check before looking at them. If any part is incomplete, we'll also tell you what is needed next.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 申込日と通知日、登録住所と送付先を分けて確認します。未完了の手続きがあれば聞き、次の通知先も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と登録と送付先と未完了手続きの有無を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the request date and notice date, and the registered address and mailing address separately. I'll ask about any unfinished procedures and confirm where the next notice will go.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the dates, registration, mailing address, and whether any procedures are incomplete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 整理してご相談くださり、ありがとうございます。担当が確認しますので、通知と控えをお手元に置いてお待ちください。それでは、引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-KURUME-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for organizing your questions. The person in charge will check, so please wait with the notice and your copy of the request at hand. I'll hand this over to them now.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学について何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with regarding the tour?

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先ほどの説明について、まだ質問があります。歩きながら聞いてもよいか迷っています。質問の時間は後でありますか。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前の説明の質問を歩行中に聞かず後の質問時間があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I still have questions about the explanation earlier. I'm unsure whether to ask while we're walking. Will there be time for questions later?
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether there will be a question period later instead of asking about the earlier explanation while walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後の説明が終わった後に質問の時間があります。今は移動を優先してください。どの説明についての質問ですか。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: There will be time for questions after the final explanation. Please focus on moving to the next place for now. Which explanation is your question about?

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の門が何度も直されたという話です。歩きながら続きを聞くより、題名だけメモして後で質問します。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の門の修理について題名だけメモし後で質問すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's about the entrance gate being repaired many times. Rather than asking for more details while walking, I'll just note the topic and ask later.
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will note only the topic of the entrance gate repairs and ask about it later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その題名を残しておいてください。次の場所では別の説明をしますので、最後の質問時間まで聞きたいことをメモしておけます。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep that topic noted. We'll give a different explanation at the next location, so you can keep notes of what you want to ask until the final question period.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「入口の門の修理」と書いておきます。次の説明の途中で割り込まず、最後の説明が終わった後に質問の順番を待ちます。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 門の修理の題名を残し次の説明を遮らず最後の説明終了後に質問の順番を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write down 'repairs to the entrance gate.' I won't interrupt the next explanation; I'll wait my turn to ask after the final explanation is over.
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the gate-repair topic noted, avoid interrupting the next explanation, and wait your turn for questions after the final explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最後に短い質問の時間があります。そこで聞き切れない場合は、案内の資料もご紹介します。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. There will be a short question period at the end. If we can't cover everything then, I'll also suggest some information materials.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質問は二つに絞ります。一つは修理と建て直しの違い、もう一つは修理に使った材料です。詳しい年代は、紹介された資料で後から調べたいです。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理と建て直しの違いと使った材料の二問に絞り年代は資料で調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll limit my questions to two: the difference between repairs and rebuilding, and the materials used in the repairs. I'd like to look up the exact dates afterward using the materials you recommend.
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask only about the difference between repairs and rebuilding and the materials used, and research the dates in the information materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の場所まで一緒に移動し、最後の説明が終わった後に、その二つをお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's move to the next place together, and please ask me those two questions after the final explanation.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。メモはしまって足元を見て移動します。最後の説明が終わってから、「門の修理」の質問を二つお伝えします。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモをしまい足元を見て移動し最後の説明終了後に門の修理の二問を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll put my notes away and watch my footing as we move. After the final explanation, I'll ask my two questions about the gate repairs.
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put your notes away, watch your footing while walking, and ask the two gate-repair questions after the final explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 最後の説明が終わった後に、二つのご質問を伺います。今は足元に気を付けて次の場所へお進みください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take your two questions after the final explanation. For now, please watch your footing and proceed to the next location. Thank you for speaking to me.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。試飲を含む見学について、ご希望やご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. Do you have any preferences or questions about the tour, which includes a tasting?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 私はお酒を飲まないので、試飲はしません。飲まずに説明だけ聞いていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 飲酒をしないため試飲を辞退し飲まず説明だけ聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: I don't drink alcohol, so I won't take part in the tasting. May I just listen to the explanation without drinking?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Decline the tasting because you do not drink alcohol and ask whether you may listen to the explanation without drinking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 説明はお聞きいただけます。器はお渡ししない形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: You're welcome to listen to the explanation. Would you prefer not to receive a tasting cup?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい、器は不要です。口に含んで出す方法でも試したくありません。見ることと説明を聞くことだけ希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 器は不要で口に含んで出す方法もせず見学と説明だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: Yes, I don't need a cup. I don't want to try even the method of tasting and spitting it out. I'd only like to observe and listen to the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you do not need a cup, do not want to taste and spit it out either, and only wish to observe and listen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。香りについての説明もありますが、器を近づけてご自身で確かめることは希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. There will also be an explanation of the aroma. Would you like to bring a cup close and check it for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 今日はそれも控えます。ほかの方が試す様子を見ながら、どんな言葉で香りを説明するのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 器の香りを直接確かめることも控え香りの説明表現を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: I'll refrain from that today too. I'd like to watch the others tasting and listen to the words used to describe the aroma.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will also refrain from smelling the cup directly and would like to hear the expressions used to describe the aroma. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 分かりました。試飲をする方の器の受け取りを妨げないよう、横の場所でお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. Please listen from the side so you don't obstruct people receiving their tasting cups.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 横へ移動します。試飲しないことで見学を途中で終える必要があるのか気になっていたので、説明に参加できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 受渡しを妨げない横へ移動し辞退しても説明参加できた安心を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: I'll move to the side. I was worried that not tasting would mean ending the tour partway through, so I'm glad I can join the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Move to the side without obstructing the handover and express relief that you can join the explanation despite declining the tasting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この説明の後も、見学案内は続きます。質問があれば説明の後に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: The tour continues after this explanation too. If you have questions, I'll take them after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。試飲はせず、説明を聞いてから次の見学へ進みます。質問ができたら、終わった時にお尋ねします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 試飲せず説明後に次の見学へ進み質問は説明終了時に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: Thank you. I'll listen without tasting and then move on to the next part of the tour. If I think of a question, I'll ask when the explanation finishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will skip the tasting, continue to the next part of the tour after the explanation, and ask questions when it ends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 試飲用の器はお渡しせず、横の場所で説明をお聞きいただく形ですね。お申し出ありがとうございました。引き続き見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-02-001-SHAR.translation: So we won't give you a tasting cup, and you'll listen to the explanation from the side. Thank you for letting us know. Please enjoy the rest of the tour.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。刺しゅうの練習で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. Are you having any difficulties with the embroidery practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 糸を強く引いたら、布にしわが寄りました。このまま次の色を縫うより、今の部分を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 糸を強く引いて布にしわが寄ったため次色に進まず修正を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: I pulled the thread hard and the fabric puckered. I'd like to fix this part now rather than stitching the next color as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that pulling the thread hard puckered the fabric, and ask about fixing it before moving on to the next color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 糸が張りすぎているようですね。この部分は練習用なので、ほどいて試し直せます。どこから強く引きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: The thread seems too tight. This is a practice section, so you can unpick it and try again. From which point did you pull hard?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 最後の三針です。しわを伸ばすために布を引っ張りましたが、戻らなかったので止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 最後の三針で強く引き布を伸ばしても戻らず止めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: The last three stitches. I pulled the fabric to smooth the puckers, but they didn't go away, so I stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that you pulled hard on the last three stitches, tried stretching the fabric without success, and stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 布を強く引かず、道具を置いてお待ちください。糸を戻す所を示します。針はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: Please don't pull the fabric hard. Put down your tools and wait. I'll show you which stitches to undo. Where is the needle?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 針は針山に戻しました。布を引かず、ほどく所を見てから自分で試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 針は針山へ戻し布を引かずほどく箇所を見て自分で試したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: I put it back in the pincushion. I'd like to avoid pulling the fabric, see where to unpick, and then try it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that the needle is back in the pincushion and you want to see where to unpick and try yourself without pulling the fabric. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こちらの三針を戻します。次は糸を強く引き切る前に、布の平らな状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: We'll undo these three stitches. Next time, check that the fabric is flat before pulling the thread all the way tight.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 三針を戻して、同じ練習場所で一針ずつ確かめます。色を変えるのは、しわが寄らないか見てもらってからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 三針を戻し一針ずつ確かめしわを見てもらってから次色へ進むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: I'll undo the three stitches and check one stitch at a time in the same practice area. I'll wait to change colors until you've checked that it isn't puckering.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will undo three stitches, check each new stitch, and move to the next color after having the fabric checked for puckering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: それで進めましょう。分からなくなったら、糸をさらに引く前に呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: Let's do that. If you're unsure, call me before pulling the thread any further.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。布の状態を見ながら練習をやり直し、迷った所で止めて声をかけます。完成を急ぐより、この部分を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 完成を急がず練習をやり直し迷えばさらに引く前に止めて声をかけると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: Yes. I'll practice this part again while watching the fabric, and stop and call you whenever I'm unsure. I'd rather check this section than rush to finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will practice again without rushing to finish, and stop and call for help before pulling further whenever unsure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ほどく三針と、次に確かめる場所をお伝えできました。やり直した一針は後で拝見します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-03-001-SHAR.translation: I've shown you the three stitches to undo and the place to check next. I'll look at your first replacement stitch later. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。運動機器について、どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. What sort of help do you need with the exercise equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 画面の時間が増えているのを見ましたが、残り時間ではないのですか。初めて使うので、開始前に表示を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 増える時間表示が残りか分からず初回開始前に説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: I saw the time on the screen increasing. Isn't that the time remaining? This is my first time using it, so please explain the display before I start.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not understand whether the increasing time display is time remaining and ask for an explanation before your first use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 今表示しているのは前の動作の経過時間です。残り時間の表示とは別です。いったん画面を初期状態へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: The current display shows elapsed time from the previous operation. That's separate from the remaining-time display. I'll reset the screen to its initial state.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 前の数字が私の設定時間ではなかったのですね。経過した時間と、私が決める運動時間を区別して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 前の利用の経過表示は自分の設定でなく経過と予定時間を別に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: So the previous number wasn't my selected exercise time. I'd like to check the elapsed time separately from the exercise duration I choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that the previous user's elapsed-time display was not your own setting and you want to check elapsed and planned time separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。機器の操作説明をしますが、今日はどのくらい歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. I'll explain how to operate the equipment. How long are you planning to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: まず短い時間で使い方を覚えたいです。機器が動けば長く続けなければならないとは思わず、止める操作も先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: まず短く操作を覚え動いたら長く続ける必要はなく停止方法も先に知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: I'd like to learn how to use it for a short time first. I don't assume I must keep going for a long time once it starts, and I'd like to know how to stop it beforehand too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you want to learn the controls briefly first, do not need to continue for a long time once it starts, and want to know how to stop it beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 開始する前に、手元の右側にある「停止」と書かれたボタンをご確認ください。この機器の操作は、スタッフと一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Before starting, please locate the button marked 'Stop' on the right near your hands. Let's check how to operate this equipment together with a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 右側の「停止」ボタンですね。必要な時はここで止めるのですね。分からなくなったら、動かしたまま画面だけを探し続けずスタッフを呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 手元右側の停止ボタンを確認し不明な時は動かしたまま画面を探し続けずスタッフを呼ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: That's the 'Stop' button on the right, then. I use it to stop when needed. If I'm unsure, I'll call a staff member rather than keep searching the screen while the machine is moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Confirm the stop button near your right hand and say you will call staff if unsure instead of continuing to search the screen while the equipment moves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では、スタッフと一緒に最初の操作を確認しましょう。今すぐ一人で始めたいということではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Let's check the first operation with a staff member. You don't mean you want to start by yourself right now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。今日は説明を受けてから一緒に開始を確認します。時間の表示と停止の方法が分かってから使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 一人ですぐ開始せず時間表示と停止方法の説明後スタッフと開始を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Correct. Today I'll get the explanation and then check how to start together with staff. I'd like to use it once I understand the time display and how to stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will not start alone immediately and want to check the start with staff after the time display and stopping method are explained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 初期画面と停止ボタンを確かめてから、スタッフと開始する形で承りました。今日は一人で操作せず、案内をお待ちください。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-04-001-SHAR.translation: Understood: you'll check the initial screen and stop button, then start with a staff member. Please don't operate it alone today; wait for assistance. Thank you for your questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: カードへの入金をご希望ですか。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Would you like to add money to your card? What are you having trouble with?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。カードを硬いケースに入れたまま機械へ差し込もうとしましたが、入りませんでした。押すのをやめたので、使い方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: ケース付きカードが差込口に入らず押すのをやめたため方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Yes. I tried to insert the card into the machine while it was still in a rigid case, but it wouldn't fit. I stopped pushing, so please tell me how to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that the card in its case would not fit the slot, that you stopped pushing, and ask what to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ケースは差し込まないでください。カードがケースから取り出せるか、ご自分で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Please don't insert the case. Can you check for yourself whether the card can be removed from it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 取り出せます。カードが曲がるほど引かず、ケースの留め具を開けて出します。ケースごと使える機械だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 留め具を開けカードを曲げず取り出しケースごと使用できると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: I can take it out. I'll open the case's clasp and remove it without pulling hard enough to bend the card. I thought the machine accepted it in the case.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that you will open the clasp and remove the card without bending it, and that you thought it could be used in its case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: カードを出せたら、こちらの案内図で入れる向きを確認してください。カード自体に割れはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Once you've removed the card, check the insertion direction in this diagram. Does the card itself have any cracks?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 見たところ割れはありません。ケースから出したカードだけを使い、向きが分からなければ差し込む前に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 見える割れはなくカード単体を使い向きは挿入前に確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: I don't see any cracks. I'll use only the card, removed from its case, and if I'm unsure of the direction, I'll ask before inserting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that there are no visible cracks, you will use the card by itself, and you will check the direction before insertion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この機械では、カードの矢印を差込口へ向け、矢印のある面を上にします。読み取り後に入金額を選びます。現金はまだ入れていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: On this machine, point the card's arrow toward the slot with the arrow side facing up. Select the amount to add after the card is read. You haven't inserted any cash yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい、現金は手元にあります。カードが正しく読まれた表示を確認してから、希望の金額を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 現金未投入で読み取り表示後に希望金額を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Correct, I still have the cash with me. I'll check the display showing that the card has been read correctly, then select the amount I want to add.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you have not inserted cash and will select the desired amount after the successful-read display appears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 入金後は、カードを取り忘れないようご確認ください。ケースはお手元で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: After adding money, please make sure you don't leave your card behind. Keep the case with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 終わったらカードを受け取り、表示された入金結果を確認してからケースへ戻します。入らない物を押し込まず相談できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 終了後カード回収と入金結果確認をしてケースへ戻すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: When it's finished, I'll collect the card, check the displayed result of the top-up, and then put it back in its case. I'm glad I asked instead of forcing in something that wouldn't fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will collect the card and check the top-up result before putting it back in the case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ケースから出したカードだけを使い、向きと読み取りの表示を確認してください。入金後の取り忘れにもお気を付けください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-05-001-SHAR.translation: Use only the card removed from its case, and check the direction and the card-read display. Please also take care not to leave it behind after adding money. Thank you for asking.
